Voice & Speech Engine Continuous Web Speech STT · Multi-Language TTS

SECTION 01 · PUBLIC EXPERIENCE

1. Public Landing Page & Visual Value Proposition

Designed to educate visitors on the capabilities of an autonomous sales assistant and drive rapid onboarding.

Figure 1.1: VOXLEAD AI Public Landing Page (Light Mode) with Top Navigation and Animated Hero Card.
Navigation & Theme Toggle

Fixed top navigation with brand mark, anchor links to Features and Workflow, instant Dark Mode toggle, and quick launch actions.

Interactive Voice Assistant Visual

Features an animated voice card displaying live soundwave bars, assistant status pills, sample conversational bubble, and language pills.

Core Value Grid

Four primary value propositions highlighting Natural Voice, Lead Intelligence, Grounded Knowledge Base, and Action-Oriented Follow-up.

Four-Step Sales Workflow

Visual step sequence: 1. Listen to customer → 2. Understand needs → 3. Qualify & capture lead → 4. Book follow-up meeting.

SECTION 02 · ACCESS CONTROL

2. Authentication & Workspace Sign-In

Secure gateway ensuring tenant isolation and persistent authenticated user sessions.

Figure 2.1: Sign In & Registration Modal with floating Theme Switcher and Client-Side Validation.
Password Security & Hashing

Enforces 8+ character passwords, encrypted using bcryptjs (12 salt rounds) before database storage.

JWT Token Lifecycle

Issues 7-day signed JSON Web Tokens stored securely in the browser's localStorage for seamless subsequent visits.

Instant Mode Switching

Toggle between "Sign In" and "Create Account" without page refreshes, retaining entered form state.

Tenant Isolation Guarantee

Every lead, conversation, appointment, and document created is linked to the user's specific MongoDB ObjectId.

SECTION 03 · EXECUTIVE COMMAND CENTER

3. Overview Dashboard & Sales Intelligence

Comprehensive real-time command center displaying lead distribution, deal pipeline, and conversational volume.

Figure 3.1: Overview Dashboard featuring 5-Card KPI Row, Dual Recharts Visualizations, Intent Breakdown, and Live Activity Feed.
5-Card KPI Matrix

Tracks Total Leads, Estimated Pipeline Value (calculated from budget extractions), Qualification Rate, Average Call Duration, and Booked Meetings.

Weekly Volume Bar Chart

Dual-bar interactive Recharts graph comparing daily customer voice sessions against high-intent qualified leads across 7 days.

Lead Readiness Donut Chart

Visual segment distribution of Hot (>=70 score), Warm (>=40 score), and Cold prospects ready for sales rep outreach.

Customer Intent & Sentiment

Progress bars highlighting top inquiries (Pricing, Demos, Integrations, Regional Voice) and real-time sentiment distribution.

SECTION 04 · CONVERSATIONAL VOICE AGENT

4. Autonomous AI Voice Agent Workspace

Continuous Web Speech voice recognition, dynamic multi-turn qualification, and real-time lead score calculation.

Figure 4.1: AI Voice Agent Workspace showing Chat Thread, Continuous Mic Controls, Live Orb, and Lead Score Track.
Continuous Voice Recognition (No Cutoffs)

Web Speech API configured with continuous listening. Displays live feedback: 'Hearing: "..."' with dedicated Stop (■) and 'Done & Send' controls.

Multi-Language Regional Voices

Native conversational responses in English, Hindi (हिन्दी), and Telugu (తెలుగు) with automated browser regional voice synthesizer matching.

Real-Time Lead Score Meter

0–100 dynamic scoring track evaluating company size, budget, urgency/timeline, and buying intent immediately as the customer speaks.

Grounded RAG Knowledge Retrieval

Answers customer questions by quoting verified company documents and FAQs rather than hallucinating pricing or terms.

SECTION 05 · CRM & PIPELINE

5. Lead Management & Prospect Records

Searchable, enriched customer relationship management database synchronized with every voice session.

Figure 5.1: Lead Management table displaying customer company, score badges, extracted budget, and pipeline status.
Automated Entity Extraction

Extracts company name, customer email, customer name, and monetary budget directly from natural voice transcripts without manual entry.

Hot / Warm / Cold Badges

High-contrast color badges reflecting buying readiness for instant prioritization by enterprise sales representatives.

Fast Filter & Search

Instant client-side text filtering by prospect name, email address, company name, or qualification category.

Lifecycle Status Tracking

Tracks deal progression from 'New' to 'In Discussion', 'Qualified', and 'Meeting Booked' directly backed by MongoDB.

SECTION 06 · MEETING SCHEDULER

6. Appointments & Demo Booking Engine

Dedicated booking workflow enabling customers and sales reps to transition conversation into scheduled calendar meetings.

Figure 6.1: Appointment booking interface and upcoming meeting queue sorted chronologically.
Two-Column Ergonomic Layout

Left panel provides rapid meeting creation with customer name, email, date, time, and purpose; right panel shows upcoming schedule.

Validation & Future Guarding

Prevents scheduling past dates and validates full email formatting before persisting to MongoDB.

Calendar Date Pill Presentation

Displays day number and abbreviated month in emerald badges for rapid visual scanning of daily appointments.

Lead Linkage

Appointments link directly to the qualified Lead ID generated during the voice conversation.

SECTION 07 · GROUNDED RAG SYSTEM

7. Knowledge Base & Grounded Retrieval

Repository of verified company facts, product catalogs, pricing tiers, and FAQs referenced by the voice agent.

Figure 7.1: Knowledge Base interface with document creator, indexed articles list, and RAG architecture briefing.
Document Authoring & Chunking

Allows adding comprehensive documents which the backend automatically chunks into 700-character segments for granular retrieval.

Keyword-Scored Relevance Engine

Analyzes customer utterance keywords against indexed company documents to find top 3 highest-matching reference snippets.

Zero-Hallucination Guardrail

Instructs the AI agent to explicitly reference verified documents or admit lack of pricing details rather than inventing facts.

Instant Document Management

One-click document deletion with real-time UI synchronization and database cleanup.

SECTION 08 · AUDIT & ANALYTICS

8. Conversation Intelligence & Audit Reports

Full transcripts, customer sentiment telemetry, and conversational summaries for management review.

Figure 8.1: Conversation Reports listing stored transcripts, timestamps, message counts, and sentiment badges.
Full Session Transcripts

Stores user voice inputs and AI audio outputs with millisecond timestamps for compliance, training, and QA audits.

Automated Summarization

Generates concise summaries of customer requirements and discussions for sales handoffs.

Sentiment Classification

Labels conversations as Positive, Neutral, or Negative (identifying objections or frustration early).

Lead Readiness Linkage

Displays Hot/Warm/Cold classification badge directly beside session metadata for fast triage.

SECTION 09 · DESIGN SYSTEM

9. Dual-Theme Experience: Emerald Dark Mode

High-contrast, eye-friendly dark aesthetic engineered specifically for high-frequency operations desks.

Figure 9.1: Overview Dashboard in Emerald Dark Mode with Deep Slate Backgrounds and Glowing Accents.
Deep Slate & Emerald Palette

Engineered with #0d1613 deep charcoal-emerald backgrounds, #14221d card elevations, and #3ed18f glowing status indicators.

High-Contrast Typography

Text elements adapt to soft off-white (#e4eee8) and muted sage (#8fa599) to eliminate eye strain during evening operations.

Consistent Component Inversion

Every element — including modal inputs, voice wave orb, SVG charts, and tables — features custom dark mode overrides.

Persistent User Choice

Theme selection is synchronized with browser localStorage, automatically loading in dark or light mode on repeat visits.
